item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a relatively humid easterly airstream, it will be mild during the day with a few mist patches over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China during the weekend.

Date/Month: 28/02 (Monday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 01/03 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Sunny intervals. Misty with one or two rain patches in the morning and at night. It will be mild.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 02/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, east force 3 to 4 later.
Weather: Misty in the morning. Sunny periods in the afternoon. It will be mild.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 03/03 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 4, force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches.
Temp range: 17 - 20 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 04/03 (Friday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.

Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent

Date/Month: 05/03 (Saturday)

Weather: Sunny intervals. Misty in the morning. One or two rain patches later. It will be mild.

Date/Month: 06/03 (Sunday)
